justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/SimplePathVisitor.java` and `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/file/CountingPathVisitor.java`. `SimplePathVisitor.AbstractBuilder` is a very small nested builder with one field (`visitFileFailedFunction`), one getter, one setter, and an empty constructor; it only configures a single behavior for `visitFileFailed`. The only direct subclass use is `CountingPathVisitor.AbstractBuilder`, which adds its own state and shows the base builder is a narrow shared hook rather than an under-decomposed class with multiple responsibilities.
